body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> novero, a company passionate about creating inspiring personal communication and entertainment solutions, today announced that Madison, the latest addition to its global lineup of leading-edge lifestyle products, will premiere at CES in Las Vegas. Designed as stylish video eyewear, Madison allows you to be immersed in a full-sized viewing experience of your favorite entertainment wherever you are. Also on-hand at novero's show-floor booth (#30170 - South Hall Upper Level) will be a complete range of the company's celebrated Bluetooth® products, currently available at select department stores, specialty boutiques, online retailers and fine jewelers around the world.

Available to demo for the first time, Madison presents the newest evolution in personal video eyewear and is the most recent example of novero's ability to deliver contemporary products that are intuitive, seamless-to-use and stylish. Madison comes with its own handheld media player, yet easily connects to other portable video players, such as mobile phones and iPods, to let you enjoy the video of your choice in any environment. Equipped with two OLED displays, Madison provides a viewing experience equal to watching a 30" display 6 feet in front of you. The intuitive menu is controlled with buttons on the media player and visual feedback is shown on an on-screen display. Madison comes with nVision software for both Windows and MAC computers that provides a simple drag-and-drop interface to easily import video files and organize your favorite TV show episodes, movies and video clips. All videos are automatically converted to a format that is optimized for Madison's screen size and resolution. With Madison, enjoying video on-the-go no longer means having to squint at a small screen, carry extra devices or deal with managing media formats.

"Like all novero products, Madison fits seamlessly into your life and simply enhances it," said Razvan Olosu, novero's CEO, from Dusseldorf. "As a company, we remain committed to merging style and sophistication with boldness and best-in-class operability to present products that inspire the user just as much as they inspire us, the creator. Our team operates on passion, and our global community of customers shares our enthusiasm for high-style and design."
In addition to Madison, CES attendees will be able to experience novero's full product line, which includes:

Victoria – A line of exquisite Bluetooth earpieces in finely crafted jewelry form that is available in two versions: The Prêt-à-Porter collection, which consists of four necklaces and also "La Première Edition" – a line of commissioned pieces fashioned from precious metals and rare jewels.

Lexington – A Bluetooth headset that goes beyond its sharp appearance to provide users an unprecedented amount of talk time: up to 20 hours, thanks to its accompanying leather wrapped charging performance dock. Lexington also features dual microphone technology with noise cancellation to ensure crisp, clear audio in any environment.

TheFirstOne – Available in winter-white and accented with polished silver, TheFirstOne is an unassuming, yet confident Bluetooth headset. TheFirstOne comes with a collection of accessories that keep it conveniently within reach at all times, including a charging car dock and desk stand, a necklace, a wearable clip and eight in-ear rings.

TheTalkyOne – Whether on a call in the office, busy at home, or running errands in the car, TheTalkyOne is a streamlined universal Bluetooth speakerphone with a single-touch button that allows calls to be managed with one press. For phones that support the feature, TheTalkyOne reads incoming texts aloud and streams music from Bluetooth-enabled phones and music players.

TheTrulyOne – For drivers who value simplicity, style and safety behind the wheel, TheTrulyOne universal Bluetooth car kit offers best-in-class audio technology along with an easy to use remote control and a stylish display screen.
TheTrustyOne – Providing users everything needed to make and receive calls on the road, TheTrustyOne universal Bluetooth car kit is a capable and uncomplicated solution for talking hands-free.

TheTravelOne – For jet setters and business travelers, TheTravelOne is a glossy universal microUSB wall charger with smooth slopes and gentle contours. It is available in white or black, and comes with adaptors for North America, EU, UK, and AUS/NZ, accommodating over 193 countries.

TheCarOne – Ensuring that automobile interiors stay pristine, and that digital accessories never lose power, TheCarOne is a chic, universal microUSB car charger that connects to any car cigarette lighter.

novero executives and designers will be on the CES show floor at booth number 30170 (South Hall Upper Level) from January 6-9, hosting meetings and demonstrating these products. For information and availability about novero solutions, please visit www.novero.com.
